decisions.boundary_condition: Apply only to flight stop selection; do not infer airline, cabin, destination, travel date, party size, or price preferences from this policy.
decisions.condition: When searching for flight itineraries for a trip, if a straight/nonstop option is available for the requested route and date.
decisions.default_action: Search for and prefer straight/nonstop flights before considering itineraries with stops.
decisions.exception_condition: If no straight/nonstop flight satisfies the required trip constraints, present itineraries with stops as fallback options and ask for confirmation before selecting one.
decisions.name: Prefers straight/nonstop flights when available
decisions.rationale: Supported by multiple examples that request a straight/nonstop flight. This is distinct from merely allowing up to one layover, so it should remain a separate soft default rather than be merged with other stop-tolerance thresholds.

decisions.boundary_condition: For round trips or multi-leg searches, apply the one-layover maximum separately to each flight or direction; this policy only governs stop count, not cabin, airline, departure time, destination, date, or exact price.
decisions.condition: When searching or comparing flight itineraries and no stricter nonstop-only requirement has been stated.
decisions.default_action: Prefer itineraries with zero or one layover only; filter out flights with two or more stops unless the user explicitly agrees to relax the cap.
decisions.exception_condition: If no zero- or one-layover itinerary satisfies the trip constraints, ask the user before considering flights with two or more stops.
decisions.name: Caps flight itineraries at one layover
decisions.rationale: Supported by multiple examples asking for no more than one layover or accepting one stop. This is a different stop-tolerance threshold from a nonstop preference and should remain separate.
